subject: Sorry about the folder mix-up
text:
Hi,

I am really sorry about the mix-up with the group project folder. I thought I had uploaded the section you gave me, but I accidentally attached the draft with my older notes and sent it out before checking carefully. I was trying to finish everything before the library closed, and I chose the wrong attachment in a hurry, which is frustrating for everyone involved. I know this made you look in the wrong place and wasted time when you are already pressed.

The deadline is too close to leave this unsolved, so I fixed it just now and posted the correct version in the shared drive. Please ignore the earlier file and use the one marked final. If anything still seems off, call me and I will answer right away.

Again, I am sorry. I should have slowed down and confirmed the upload before moving on. I appreciate you being patient with me today. It was careless of me. I am embarrassed.
